status: FLAGGED — C2 NOT PASSABLE UNDER EITHER TARGET SET
c2_rule: C2 requires every target row in A-K+ to keep K, in A+K- to keep A, in Y_MINUS_A+K+ to keep A and K while Y is blocked, and in Y_MINUS_A-K+ to keep K while A and Y are blocked. A row that cannot meet a cell fails the seed because C2 is all-row and per-seed.

comparison.disposition: N20 does not reduce C2 exposure. It adds rows and failing cells, retains every N4 carrier-missing row, and leaves both designs with no C2-viable seed. The C2 gate is therefore not adjudicable under either target set as currently selected.

disposition: Do not treat N20 as a C2 repair. If C2 must be adjudicable, the target block needs a new pre-outcome viability criterion; a post-outcome swap is not permitted. Until then, record C2 as not adjudicable rather than freezing a target set that cannot pass it.
not_evidence: A read-only target-viability report over no-arm artifacts. It runs no A1 cell, freezes no target, makes no causal or capability claim, and does not measure C2 or any treatment effect.
